order: rotate P1/P4 per rep, alternate arms per rep+cell
purpose: Stage attribution only; not a new performance/adoption gate
exit: Identify one next candidate supported by per-child stage data, or stop inconclusive. Do not implement the candidate.
criteria: all 576 SQL oracles and cleanup pass
exact child-to-trace and owner mapping, no truncated owner traces
per-child partition nonnegative and reconciles to external Fork
image build occurs only in root Start, separate from child Fork
p50/p95/>100ms and every pair retained; no tail exclusion
P4 elapsed attribution is not exclusive CPU attribution
remaining_limitations: observer changes scheduling and time; historical ordinary performance judgment unchanged
execute_to_ready includes guest, scheduler and transport; does not prove file fault or InnoDB mechanism
